scripts.text:
DECLARE @fileNameWithPath VARCHAR(300)
DECLARE @tidalJobNo VARCHAR(50)
DECLARE @fileDefId INT
DECLARE @env VARCHAR(50)

DECLARE @File TABLE (fileId INT)
DECLARE @fileId INT

DECLARE @fileStatusConfigId INT
DECLARE @dupeSubPath VARCHAR(50) = ''

DECLARE @now DATETIME


/*
SET @fileDefId = 2
SET @fileNameWithPath = 'c:\Temp\test.txt'
SET @tidalJobNo = '123'
SET @env = 'LOCDEV'
*/

SET @fileDefId = @fileDefId
SET @fileNameWithPath = @fileNameWithPath
SET @tidalJobNo = @tidalJobNo
SET @env = @env

SET @now = GETDATE()

--create file
INSERT INTO [File].[File] (fileDefId, fileNameWithPath, tidalJobNo, runStart, fileStatusConfigId)
OUTPUT INSERTED.fileId INTO @File
SELECT 
	@fileDefId, 
	@fileNameWithPath, 
	@tidalJobNo, 
	DATEADD(SS, -2, @now), --subtract seconds to ensure sequence
	353 --start

SET @fileId = (SELECT fileId FROM @File)

--create hist
SET @fileStatusConfigId = 353 --start
INSERT INTO [File].FileStatusHist (fileId, fileStatusConfigId, histDateTime, userId)
SELECT @fileId, @fileStatusConfigId, DATEADD(SS, -2, @now), 1

--move to next status; create hist
SET @fileStatusConfigId = 351 --validation
UPDATE F SET fileStatusConfigId = @fileStatusConfigId FROM [File].[File] F WHERE fileId = @fileId
INSERT INTO [File].FileStatusHist (fileId, fileStatusConfigId, histDateTime, userId)
SELECT @fileId, @fileStatusConfigId, DATEADD(SS, -1, @now), 1

--check for dupe file by searching for filename
IF EXISTS(
	SELECT 1 
	FROM [File].[File] F 
	WHERE F.fileName = dbo.fnGetFileName(@fileNameWithPath) 
		AND F.fileDefId = @fileDefId 
		AND F.fileStatusConfigId NOT IN (350) --350=unstable; if the previous file was not loaded because it was 350, then its not a dupe
		AND F.fileId <> @fileId) --not itself
BEGIN
	--update status; create hist
	SET @fileStatusConfigId = 349 --dupe
	UPDATE F SET fileStatusConfigId = @fileStatusConfigId FROM [File].[File] F WHERE fileId = @fileId
	INSERT INTO [File].FileStatusHist (fileId, fileStatusConfigId, histDateTime, userId)
	SELECT @fileId, @fileStatusConfigId, @now, 1
	SET @dupeSubPath = 'Dupe' + REPLACE(REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), GETDATE(), 20), ' ', '-'), ':', '-') + '\' --get subfoldername like DupeYYYY-MM-DD-HH-MM-SS\
END

SELECT
	fileId = @fileId,
	fileStatusConfigId = @fileStatusConfigId,
	D.fileFormatConfigId,
	archivePath = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(D.archivePath, '#rootPath#', R.configValue), '#yyyy#', LTRIM(YEAR(GETDATE()))), '#mm#', LTRIM(MONTH(GETDATE()))) + @dupeSubPath,
	archiveFileNameWithPath = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(D.archivePath, '#rootPath#', R.configValue), '#yyyy#', LTRIM(YEAR(GETDATE()))), '#mm#', LTRIM(MONTH(GETDATE()))) + @dupeSubPath + F.fileName,
	unstableCheckTime = TRY_PARSE((SELECT TOP 1 configValue FROM App.Config WHERE configKey = 'UnstableCheckTime') AS INT),
	D.storedProc,
	origFileNameWithPath = @fileNameWithPath
FROM [File].FileDef D
INNER JOIN [File].[File] F ON F.fileDefId = D.fileDefId
INNER JOIN App.Config M ON M.configId = D.fileFormatConfigId
INNER JOIN App.Config E ON E.configKey LIKE 'Env.%'
INNER JOIN App.Config R ON R.envConfigId = E.configId
	AND R.configKeyNode = 'RootPath'
WHERE E.configKey = 'Env.' + UPPER(@env)
	AND F.fileId = @fileId

DECLARE @fileId INT
DECLARE @fileStatusConfigId INT
DECLARE @now DATETIME

/*
SET @fileId = 1
*/

SET @fileId = @fileId

SET @now = GETDATE()

--update status; create hist
SET @fileStatusConfigId = 352 --read
UPDATE F SET fileStatusConfigId = @fileStatusConfigId FROM [File].[File] F WHERE fileId = @fileId
INSERT INTO [File].FileStatusHist (fileId, fileStatusConfigId, histDateTime, userId)
SELECT @fileId, @fileStatusConfigId, @now, 1

DECLARE @fileId INT
DECLARE @fileStatusConfigId INT
DECLARE @now DATETIME
DECLARE @errorDesc VARCHAR(8000)

/*
SET @fileId = 1
SET @errorDesc = ''
*/

SET @fileId = @fileId
SET @errorDesc = @env

SET @now = GETDATE()

--update status; create hist
SET @fileStatusConfigId = 352 --validation
UPDATE F SET fileStatusConfigId = @fileStatusConfigId, runEnd=@now FROM [File].[File] F WHERE fileId = @fileId
INSERT INTO [File].FileStatusHist (fileId, fileStatusConfigId, histDateTime, userId)
SELECT @fileId, @fileStatusConfigId, @now, 1

IF ISNULL(@errorDesc,'') <> ''
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO App.Log(logTypeConfigId, logDateTime, userId, id, logNoes)
	VALUES (394, GETDATE(), 1, @fileId, @errorDesc) --394 means LogType.File
END

DECLARE @fileId INT
DECLARE @fileStatusConfigId INT
DECLARE @now DATETIME
DECLARE @sql VARCHAR(MAX)
DECLARE @storedProc VARCHAR(MAX)

/*
SET @fileId = 1
*/

SET @fileId = @fileId
SET @storedProc = @storedProc

SET @now = GETDATE()

--update status; create hist
SET @fileStatusConfigId = 395 --process
UPDATE F SET fileStatusConfigId = @fileStatusConfigId FROM [File].[File] F WHERE fileId = @fileId
INSERT INTO [File].FileStatusHist (fileId, fileStatusConfigId, histDateTime, userId)
SELECT @fileId, @fileStatusConfigId, @now, 1


--prepare sproc call with paramter and execute
SET @SQL = @storedProc + ' @fileId=' + LTRIM(@fileId)
EXEC (@SQL)


SET @now = GETDATE()

--update status; create hist
SET @fileStatusConfigId = 396 --complete
UPDATE F SET fileStatusConfigId = @fileStatusConfigId FROM [File].[File] F WHERE fileId = @fileId
INSERT INTO [File].FileStatusHist (fileId, fileStatusConfigId, histDateTime, userId)
SELECT @fileId, @fileStatusConfigId, @now, 1

SET @fileStatusConfigId = @fileStatusConfigId

DECLARE @fileId INT
DECLARE @archiveFileNameWithPath VARCHAR(8000)

/*
SET @fileId = 1
SET @archiveFileNameWithPath = ''
*/

SET @fileId = @fileId
SET @archiveFileNameWithPath = @archiveFileNameWithPath

UPDATE F SET archiveFileNameWithPath=@archiveFileNameWithPath, runEnd=GETDATE() FROM [File].[File] F WHERE fileId = @fileId

IF @fileDefId = 2 BEGIN UPDATE C SET configValue = '834 Enrollment File Import completed successfully on ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), GETDATE(), 20) + '.' FROM App.Config C WHERE C.configKey = 'HomeSummaryAnnouncement.4' AND C.profileConfigId = 16 END
